volume.tooltip: Speaker level (−∞…0 dB). 0 dB is unity. Default −3 dB. Old patches that stored 0…1 linear Volume are converted on load. Type a dB value (or −inf).

pan.tooltip: Stereo balance after Mono is summed in. 0 = unchanged (Mono to both). −1 = left only. +1 = right only.

stereoMode.tooltip: Dual: a full set of taps for each side. Right taps sit between the Left taps and get their own random offsets and drift. Split: one set of taps, every other tap goes Left or Right. Mono: the original single set of taps, same signal on Mix L and Mix R.

delays.tooltip: Number of parallel delay taps. 1 = a single delay of Time.

time.tooltip: Farthest tap of the exponential layout. Shorter taps pack toward 0 (k=3).

mix.tooltip: Dry/wet on Mix L and Mix R. 0 = dry In, 1 = mixed taps.

randomOffset.tooltip: Multiplies each tap's seeded random [0,1] extra delay. 0 = exponential times only. 0.05 s = each tap adds 0…50 ms from Seed.

driftSpeed.tooltip: How fast each tap's FBM drift wanders. 0 = frozen. 0.25 Hz = slow wander.

driftAmp.tooltip: Depth of the per-tap drift as a fraction of that tap's delay. 0.1 = up to +-10% time. 0 = no drift.

seed.tooltip: Chooses the random extra delay for each tap. Random Offset scales those values.

interpolate.tooltip: Off = classic hold. Linear / Smoothstep glide from previous hold to the new sample over the clock period (Sample Freq) or last Clock interval. Applies to Ext and internal Left/Right.

polarity.tooltip: Bipolar = −1…1 (raw hold / noise). Unipolar = 0…1 on audio outs for MOD into unipolar params (Sweep, Frequency, etc.) without a B2U. Face/waterfall reads Left Raw / Right Raw (bipolar full height; ignores Polarity), same spirit as Amplitude.

amplitude.tooltip: Scale Ext Out (and L/R audio). Face Left Raw / Right Raw always show full hold. 0 = mute, 1 = full. Use instead of an external attenuverter for MOD depth.

seed.tooltip: Internal noise seed (Left/Right lanes). Same Seed = same held values.

tuning.tooltip: A4 reference Hz. MIDI 69 maps to this frequency when converting Pitch→Hz.

octave.tooltip: Add octaves to the zero-based pitch before Hz conversion.

semitones.tooltip: Add semitones to the zero-based pitch before Hz conversion.

cents.tooltip: Add cents / 100 to the zero-based pitch before Hz conversion.

multiply.tooltip: Hz-domain multiply after Pitch→Hz. Applies to ƒ and inc, not the ♯/♭ thru.

add.tooltip: Hz-domain offset after Multiply. Applies to ƒ and inc, not the ♯/♭ thru.

upShape.tooltip: Rising glide curve. Lin = constant rate. Log = fast start, eases in. Exp = slow start, finishes quickly. Smooth = slow start and end.

downShape.tooltip: Falling glide curve. Lin = constant rate. Log = fast start, eases in. Exp = slow start, finishes quickly. Smooth = slow start and end.

upTime.tooltip: Seconds to reach a higher target from the current value (any amplitude — Hz, CV, audio). 0 = instant.

downTime.tooltip: Seconds to reach a lower target from the current value (any amplitude). 0 = instant.

bias.tooltip: Offset added before slew (0…1). Hidden by default — show it to step the target by hand.

source.tooltip: Sine. Dithered Sine = Robin Schmidt cycle-length dither. Trisaw = dithered naive trisaw. Soft Square = soundemote.dev SquareToSine. Soft Tri = the soundemote.dev Diroxe tri.

frequency.tooltip: Default slider 0…20 kHz. Pitch MOD can run down through 0. Thru-zero: enable Bipolar on Frequency (domain-add MOD). Domain min/max are slider guides. Wired ƒ replaces this knob.

morph.tooltip: Shape per source. Sine: none. Dithered Sine: dither amount (0 = plain sine). Trisaw: peak position (0.5 = triangle, edges = saw). Soft Square: 0 = sine, 0.5 = soft square, 1 = near-hard square. Soft Tri: 0 = sharp triangle, 1 = rounded.

pitchMod.tooltip: Slider 0..4800 cents (4 octaves), 300 c at the middle for fine vibrato-to-noise control. 1σ exponential pitch wobble in cents around the effective frequency. 0 = none.

ampMod.tooltip: Level-preserving full-band noise AM. 1 = full ring mod (no carrier).

color.tooltip: Noise for audio, Pitch Mod and Amp Mod. White = flat (uniform) distribution, Gaussian = normal, Average = Gaussian with 2-sample averaged Pitch Mod noise (smoother, null at Nyquist). Pink / Brown spectral colors. All unit std, so Pitch Mod cents stay true.

seed.tooltip: Master seed. Reset jack reseeds every generator from this value.
